g.text: UML - Implemented authenticated finality, suspense and linked returns
verify live HMAC and timestamp; validate typed scope
durable audit and owned investigation case
original evidence identity + full digest; durable acceptance
Global evidence ID cannot be reused across types.
A replay never overwrites original financial facts.
recover finality receipt, otherwise apply archived packet
atomic hold consumption + balanced principal/fee journal
daily usage POSTED + immutable finality receipt
exact submitted hold release + usage RELEASED + finality
Lost acknowledgment is recovered by original business identity.
Contradictory final evidence cannot release a consumed hold.
settle / decline / cancel only against Core receipt
derive target and owner from Core reference / original payer
lock original settled payment; sum all accepted returns
accepted total + new principal <= original principal
Original journal, fee and gross daily usage remain intact.
one balanced clearing -> suspense journal + movement receipt
owned payment case; retain funds in suspense
signed current checks for Core-derived customer
retain suspense; own review / denied handling
allocate exact movement with trusted expiring permit
ordered account locks; recheck current destination and permit
atomic suspense -> customer journal + allocation receipt
authoritative booking, allocation and return totals
original SETTLED payment + separate return summary / history
Only Core allocation makes incoming funds available.
Unconfirmed DRAFT cancellation has no financial effect.
Submitted cancellation uses the separate original-identity recovery workflow.
